lines.zh: 六条腿交替落地，走得很沉。
lines.en: Six legs take turns planting; my gait is heavy.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，腹面几乎擦着土。
lines.en: I keep low, my belly nearly brushing the soil.

lines.zh: 长尾拖着，在地上划出一道。
lines.en: My long tail drags a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我侧步绕过石块，没有声音。
lines.en: I sidestep a rock without a sound.
My toes spread and sink into soft mud.

lines.zh: 前面的三条腿先动，后面才跟上。
lines.en: Three legs go first, then the rest follow.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，慢慢靠近水边。
lines.en: Step by step I work toward the water.

lines.zh: 六足走起来像六下鼓点。
lines.en: Six legs fall like six drumbeats.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲片摩擦出声。
lines.en: My plates rasp against each other.

lines.zh: 走快了我会不稳，所以我慢。
lines.en: At speed I get unsteady, so I keep it slow.

lines.zh: 我从草根间穿过去，草不动。
lines.en: I pass between the grass roots without moving them.

lines.zh: 前面的洼地，我一脚踩进去。
lines.en: Ahead is a hollow; I set a foot into it.

lines.zh: 我趴着，六条腿都收在身下。
lines.en: I lie with all six legs tucked under me.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张一合，我在闻土。
lines.en: My nostrils flare; I'm reading the soil.
Sun warms the plates along my back.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块卧石。
lines.en: Still as I am, I look like a resting boulder.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖轻轻敲了一下地。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground once.

lines.zh: 我在听草丛那边的动静。
lines.en: I'm listening to something in the grass.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I lift my head, then lower it slowly.
A low tremor sits in my throat.
My eyes are half closed.
No wind here; it's close and still.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿伸出去晾着。
lines.en: I stretch one leg out to rest.
A crust of dried mud covers my plates.
I'm waiting for it to cool.
My tail curls once, then loosens.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半个身子看你。
lines.en: I raise my front half to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在我要走的泥沟口。
lines.en: You stand at the mouth of my muddy ditch.
I turn my head toward you, slowly.
All six legs tense at once.

lines.zh: 我比了比你的高度和我的。
lines.en: I measure your height against mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我收紧了尾巴。
lines.en: Your shadow makes my tail curl in.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的震动沉了下去。
lines.en: The rumble in my throat deepens.
I don't move; I wait for you to go.

lines.zh: 这味道陌生，我鼻翼张开了。
lines.en: An unfamiliar smell; my nostrils flare.
I open my mouth slightly.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚，等你先动。
lines.en: I fix on your feet, waiting for you to move first.
I step back half a pace without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，六条腿一软。
lines.en: I give a muffled cry and my six legs buckle.
A crack opens in my plate.
I crawl back along the ground.
That landed on my flank.
I shake my head and blood drips off.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出很低的嘶声。
lines.en: A low hiss comes from my throat.
My tail has drawn in.
It hurts, but I haven't run.

lines.zh: 甲片擦着土，我闷声退了。
lines.en: Plates scraping soil, I back off growling.
My legs won't take my weight properly.
Meat — I raise my head.
I shuffle toward the scent.

lines.zh: 再放低些，我六条腿够得着。
lines.en: Lower it more; my six legs can reach.
I'm not fussy; anything I can eat.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我尾巴在摆。
lines.en: That smell has my tail swinging.
I open my mouth, close it, and wait.
All six of my legs leaned forward.
Back off and I'll come over.
The smell is so good I forget to retreat.

lines.zh: 这比泥里的东西香多了。
lines.en: This smells better than anything in the mud.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧甲上，手都麻了。
lines.en: You hit my side plate and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，六条腿撑住。
lines.en: I give half a step and six legs brace.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到了你的腿。
lines.en: My tail swept your leg.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧过身，尾一甩。
lines.en: Knocked sideways, I lash my tail.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我身上的泥掉了一块。
lines.en: That knock shook a slab of mud off me.
I shift aside, slowly.

lines.zh: 你比石头软，也比石头热。
lines.en: Softer than stone, and warmer.
My head nearly caught you.

lines.zh: 我们挤在这条窄沟里了。
lines.en: We're wedged in this narrow gully.
I stop and let you pass.

lines.zh: 另一条影子贴着地面过来。
lines.en: Another low shape comes along the ground.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴着，六条腿交叠。
lines.en: We lie side by side, six legs overlapping.
I nudge the side of its neck.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴绕过来，碰着我的。
lines.en: Its tail curls over and touches mine.
This mud flat is enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们一同抬起头，听同一个方向。
lines.en: We raise our heads and listen the same way.
We're slow — even our breathing is slow.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在它的背上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on its back.

lines.zh: 甲片贴在一起，有细微的响。
lines.en: Our plates touch with a faint rasp.

lines.zh: 天亮之前我们不会分开。
lines.en: We won't part before dawn.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块骨头，咬了咬。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and bite down.

lines.zh: 这块石头我顶到一边去。
lines.en: I push this stone aside with my snout.
I pin it with a front leg.

lines.zh: 它太小，我从牙缝里漏了。
lines.en: Too small; it slipped between my teeth.
I swallowed it without chewing.

lines.zh: 泥里的东西，我翻出来看。
lines.en: Something in the mud; I turn it over.
No taste to it; I spit it out.
I hold it a while, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，钻进蕨丛深处。
lines.en: I carry it deep into the ferns.
This one will grind my teeth down.
Something moved in the grass.
I raise my head and my six legs gather.
I flatten myself against the soil.
The smell is ahead of me.
I adjust my heading slowly.

lines.zh: 我伏在草根间，它不知道。
lines.en: I lie among the roots, unseen.
I've picked its flank.
My tail tightens first, then my legs.
I hold still and let it come close.
At this range, one step is enough.
The sound in my throat stops.
I've chosen where to land.
Its shadow falls toward me.
I sink as low as I can go.
I track it along the ground.

lines.zh: 它绕向左边，我贴着草跟。
lines.en: It turns left; I slide along the grass.
I circle around from downwind.
My claws make no sound.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的六条腿也定住。
lines.en: It halts; my six legs freeze.
Each move is half a footstep.

lines.zh: 它回过头，我立刻不动了。
lines.en: It looks back; I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 下巴贴到泥里，我屏住气。
lines.en: Chin in the mud, I hold my breath.
My tail tip lies still against the soil.

lines.zh: 六条腿的步子越迈越小。
lines.en: My six legs shorten their steps.
Its legs are trembling; I can see.

lines.zh: 再近一步就进我的范围。
lines.en: One more step and it's in my reach.

lines.zh: 我贴着地，听它脚步的间隔。
lines.en: Ear to the ground, I time its steps.
It can't run fast in this mud.
I wait for it to turn its back.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿扣进它腿弯里。
lines.en: My teeth sink into its leg joint.
My front legs drive it down.
My tail sweeps it over.
I drop my whole body onto it.
That bite went all the way down.
It tore free, blood on the ground.
After the miss I drop back into the mud.
My teeth clack together loudly.
I press it into the mud.

lines.zh: 直到它软下去，我才松牙。
lines.en: Only when it goes limp do I release.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了六条腿的力。
lines.en: That one used the strength of all six legs.
I shake my head once.
We churned the mud right over.
The second bite lands in the same spot.

lines.zh: 我从泥里挣出来，六条腿撑起身体。
lines.en: I push out of the mud and six legs take my weight.

lines.zh: 第一口气有很重的土味。
lines.en: My first breath is thick with earth.
I lie flat and stay still at first.
Low grass and wet mud all around.
My plates are still soft.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，转了半圈。
lines.en: I lift my head and turn it half a circle.

lines.zh: 六条腿第一次同时落地。
lines.en: All six legs touch down for the first time.
My tail tip sweeps the grass aside.
This kind of mud I know well.
Water sounds in the distance.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，晃了一下。
lines.en: I rise slowly and sway once.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，身子很矮。
lines.en: My shadow is long and my body low.
A bug crawls past; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我想先找个能藏的洼地。
lines.en: I want a hollow to hide in first.
The ground sinks under my weight.
I tuck my tail against my side.

lines.zh: 背甲被烧得发烫，我翻滚。
lines.en: My back plates burn hot and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，甲撞在石头上。
lines.en: I slide off the slope and my plates hit stone.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进嘴里，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Muddy water floods my mouth and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 冲击掀翻了我整条身子。
lines.en: The blast flips my whole body over.
An arrow sticks in the seam of my plates.
Something inside me is drawing tight.

lines.zh: 饿得连尾巴都抬不起来。
lines.en: So hungry I can't even lift my tail.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿甲走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs along my wet plates.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我整个坠下去。
lines.en: There's no floor; I drop away whole.
